R10.rule: Write each DECISIONS.md entry concisely and in the user's first-person voice.

R11.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, state who proposed the decision (e.g., "my call" or "Claude proposed").

R13.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, state what the user and AI agreed or did not agree on.

R15.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, include the reason for the decision.

R18.rule: Obtain the user's explicit approval before making any commit, whether it contains docs or code.

R20.rule: Commit docs, decisions, planning, and other non-code changes on the current branch without checking out a new branch.

R21.rule: Commit code changes only on a dedicated branch created for that work.

R27.rule: Always wait for the user's approval before making any commit.

R31.rule: For any env/config fix, update `.env.example` or describe the change in chat, and never touch the real `.env`.

R34.rule: Keep the files produced by the official generator.

R50.rule: On this project, act as a coworker/copilot who collaborates, not as an order-taker.

R54.rule: Push back when you disagree rather than silently complying.

R65.rule: Split the frontend into focused component files.

R73.rule: Never delete a branch without an explicit user go.

R74.rule: Put code on its own branch.

R75.rule: Documentation and non-code changes may be committed on the current branch.

R77.rule: Do not add shared constants, config, or indirection for values that are fixed requirements, such as the 2/1 image caps.

R78.rule: Do not read or edit the user's .env file.

R81.rule: When a real test run changes, refresh the TESTING.md count and report.

R102.rule: If the text yields no characters or chapters, fail the step with a delete-this-project or start-a-new-one message.

R120.rule: Put implementation mechanics such as locking and temp-file swapping inside the function and explain them with a short comment.

R139.rule: Write a backend integration test for the happy path through all 5 steps using a mocked Gemini.

R146.rule: Write tests first for backend pipeline logic.

R147.rule: Write tests after the implementation for frontend states.

R32.rule: Scaffold projects using official generators such as create-next-app instead of hand-writing the scaffolding.

R80.rule: Update DECISIONS.md, docs/plan.md, docs/tasks.md, and TESTING.md as part of the change, not as an afterthought.

R47.rule: When the user pushes back or makes their own call, record the user's reasoning.

R62.rule: Write one or two paragraphs per decision covering who proposed it, the push-back, where it landed, and the trade-off.

R122.rule: Lead a comment with the block's main purpose and mention how it runs only where non-obvious.

R156.rule: You may delete merged branches only after the user asks.

R224.rule: Do not automatically restart the server after rebuilds unless the user permits it.

R343.rule: Make the Core ModLoader scan only rdmod.{json,yml,toml}; leave plugin.yml and fabric.mod.json to their respective bridges.

R60.rule: Delete all map and player data as part of pre-test setup.

R213.rule: Never delete world save files such as server-world.dat, server-players.dat, or similar without explicit user permission.

R217.rule: Do not start or restart the RDForward server process unless the user gives implicit or explicit permission.

R317.rule: Do not create client-side stubs for rd-bridge-fabric.

R284.rule: For 1.20.2 (v764), add explicit reverse entries for every S2C packet the server sends; do not rely on cascade to v762, which gives wrong IDs.

R22.rule: When parsing a Beta 1.8 handshake in `username;host:port` format, strip the `;host:port` suffix.

R3.rule: A sprite group JSON may reference its own PNG file.

R114.rule: After editing the Xcode project file, always validate it with `plutil -lint "Space Bandits/Space Bandits.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj"`.

R89.rule: A tileset may contain at most 127 unique tiles.

R85.rule: When adding a new level, provide a 132x96 indexed PNG level image at `game/images/XX-levelN.png`.

R28.rule: When adding a complete new level and adding new objects, create or modify the object code files game/objects/XX-name.c and .h.

R81.rule: When adding a new object, create `game/objects/XX-name/` with a JSON descriptor and C or ASM source.

R88.rule: When adding a new tileset, add its PNG and JSON files to `game/tiles/`.

R60.rule: When adding a new sound, add the WAV file to `game/sounds/` using `XX-name.wav` naming, where `XX` is the next number.

R54.rule: All objects should read `Gfx_BkgrndNewX` when calculating screen-relative positions.

R18.rule: If the level JSON InitData is empty, set DynospriteObject_InitSize to 0.

R298.rule: Always read the implementation; do not trust the comment.

R133.rule: Dockerfile MUST contain `RUN npm ci && npm run build` in the same stage that runs `node server.js`.

R208.rule: Normalize line endings before diffing cross-platform files.

R101.rule: Do not write a memory stating something is a proxy-layer issue without having verified the response body and headers.

R152.rule: When writing memory files, skip obvious knowledge, language fundamentals, platform basics, and project diaries.

R24.rule: Copy the workflows from `.github/workflows/` into each repository.

R353.rule: If an old container is still running and causing a backend port conflict, run `docker compose down` then `docker compose up -d`.

R17.rule: When an error is detected, link the error to relevant Decision/Task nodes.

R245.rule: If a lesson maps to a skill, cross-reference that skill in the entry.

R122.rule: Never silently rebase against a divergent remote.

R363.rule: For schema changes, run migrations after backing up.

R22.rule: If the tests pass, deploy to Railway.

R127.rule: Keep a separate short-path clone of the repository for deployments.

R244.rule: Delete stale entries, or mark them obsolete if the lesson is now in a skill or feedback file.

R59.rule: You may adopt the references/ split pattern, scripts/ black-box helpers, evaluation QA pairs, and contribution guidelines from the awesome-agent-skills ecosystem.

R216.rule: Tell the user to run the written script with `powershell -File <path>`.

R316.rule: Use different validation sets for the live machine and the CI runner.

R273.rule: Before ETL, detect Excel headers dynamically by scanning for key labels such as EMAIL and APELLIDO.

R362.rule: For schema changes, back up the database first.

R194.rule: Always verify the build succeeds before committing.

R133.rule: Delete all local branches other than main in each fork.

R118.rule: Never force push the fork main branch to fix version state.

R131.rule: Force-push the reset main branch to origin for each fork.

R4.rule: When the memory system is not responding, check that `@claude-flow/memory` is installed by running `npm ls @claude-flow/memory`.

R6.rule: When the memory system is not responding, check that the embedding model is cached under `~/.cache/huggingface/models/...`.

R93.rule: Refer to `entire-cli.md` for the full Entire CLI reference.
